questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question probes practical design for per-tenant feature gating in CNF gateways, including secure identity, dynamic policy delivery, and runtime enforcement. It emphasizes end-to-end testability and real-world trade-offs between performance and isolation.

## Key Concepts

- per-tenant policy CRD
- bidirectional gRPC capability negotiation
- in-memory enforcement with cache invalidation
- SPIFFE/SVID-based mutual TLS for control plane–sidecar trust
- canary-friendly rollout and end-to-end validation

## Code Example

```yaml
# Minimal CRD blueprint (high level)
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: cnffeaturepolicies.example.com
spec:
  group: example.com
  versions:
    - name: v1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                tenantID:
                  type: string
                features:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: string
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: cnffeaturepolicies
    singular: cnffeaturepolicy
    kind: CNFFeaturePolicy
    shortNames: [cfp]
```

```yaml
# Sample policy (per-tenant)
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: CNFFeaturePolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-policy
spec:
  tenantID: tenant-a
  features:
    - QUIC
    - TLS13
    - multiplexing
```

```yaml
# Minimal end-to-end test manifest (one namespace)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: gateway
          image: mycnf/gateway:latest
          args: ["--config", "/etc/gateway/config.yaml"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/gateway
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: gateway-config
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical skills in implementing controlled, observable deployments in a multi-tenant CNF gateway environment. It checks familiarity with canary strategies, per-tenant isolation, and metric-driven promotion/rollback.

## Key Concepts

- Canary deployments with Argo Rollouts
- Per-tenant traffic shaping and isolation
- Prometheus-based SLIs and analysis templates
- Automated rollback and promotion thresholds
- End-to-end testing in a single-tenant namespace before broader rollout

## Code Example

```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout-tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
      tenant: a
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
        tenant: a
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: registry.example.com/cnf/gateway:latest
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
      - setWeight: 10
      - pause: { duration: 5m }
      - setWeight: 100
      analysis:
        templates:
        - templateName: canary-metrics
        metrics:
        - name: latency
          interval: 30s
          successCondition: result < 0.001 * 0.15
        - name: error-rate
          interval: 30s
          successCondition: result < 0.005
```

```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
```
